Hi Carlos. Let's practice for Tuesday. I am the buyer now. What do you do at Sucafina?
I am a sustainability analyst. Every week I check the farm data in the IMS system.
And what are you working on right now?
Right now I am preparing the EUDR maps for twelve farms. It is a big project.
Can your team provide the maps before December?
Yes, we can. But we can't provide the training records this month.
OK. Did you visit any farms last month?
Yes, I did. I visited Boa Vista, and I found two small issues.
Very good. In my first meeting with a buyer, I was very nervous. You are calm!
Thank you, Emma. Next month I am going to visit three new farms.

Six months ago, I didn't write emails in English. I always used a translator. Now I can read a sustainability report, and I can write a short email to Emma. Every week I study with my teacher, and right now I am preparing for my first meeting with a buyer. Last month I visited three farms, and I wrote all the reports in English. It was not easy, but I did it. Next month I am going to present the Brazil results to the team in Geneva. My goal is simple: to speak slowly, clearly and with confidence.

Hi Carlos, it's Emma. Some news about Tuesday. Mr. Becker can't join at ten, so the meeting is at eleven now. He is traveling in Colombia this week, and he is visiting coffee farms there. He sent me two questions about Brazil. How many farms are in our EUDR project? And when did you visit them? Please bring the numbers to the meeting. And don't worry, he speaks slowly. See you on Tuesday.
